name: Beyblade X
description: Beginner blader Robin Kazami joins up with influencer Multi Nana-iro and former champion Jaxon Cross to form this unlikely trio - ready to climb to the top of The X and win the title of champion blader!

videos.title: New Chapter Celebration! Grand Reopening of Beyblade Sushi - Go Shoot!
X
videos.overview: After his teammates leave, amateur Blader Robin Kazami has no choice but to join the mysterious Blader X.

videos.title: Multi-Colored Ambush
videos.overview: After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.

videos.title: Team Persona
videos.overview: After their battle with the mega-popular Multi Nana-iro, Jaxon set his sights on a potential third member for Team Persona.

videos.title: Bey Sponsor
videos.overview: Now that they're officially pros, the hunt is on for Team Persona's Bey Sponsor, who will help them train and climb The X.

videos.title: To The X
videos.overview: Now that Team Persona is officially sponsored by Komaba Sushi, the team is finally ready to battle at The X.

videos.title: Lion's Jungle
videos.overview: Instead of training, Robin, Jaxon, and Multi set off to Lion's Jungle to scout out their opponents, Team Zooganic, and see if they could gather any intel.

videos.title: Team Zooganic
videos.overview: It's Team Persona's debut match, and they're set to go head-to-head with the inimitable Team Zooganic.

videos.title: The Mask and the King
videos.overview: The Persona-Zooganic showdown is locked at one point each. It has all come down to Jaxon's battle with Zooganic's leader, Titus Manju.

videos.title: Beycrafter
videos.overview: After their victory against Team Zooganic, Multi uses some Beycrafting skills to help Robin improve his game.

videos.title: The Pro Realm
videos.overview: Team Phalanx is hanging on to their sponsorship by a thread. Their upcoming match with Team Persona is their last chance to stay in the limelight.

videos.title: Warden's Exam
videos.overview: After failing Warden's Exam, Robin wonders if he can ever get to the same level as his teammates.

videos.title: The Final Battle
videos.overview: Team Persona enters the Solo Battle Fest, a series of exhibition matches.

videos.title: The First Fan
videos.overview: With all eyes on Blader X and Multi Nana-iro, Robin finds his first fan.

videos.title: Jax-ercise
videos.overview: Ms. Myoden informs everyone that a new Blader has broken Jaxon's record.

videos.title: Riddles and Beys
videos.overview: At Zonamos House Bladers can not only battle but also solve riddles

videos.title: Noblesse Oblige
videos.overview: Team Persona have just one riddle left to solve!

videos.title: Bey Timeshift
videos.overview: A mysterious Bey has been distributed all over the city.

videos.title: Pride
videos.overview: After switching their Beys, Team Phalanx is on a winning streak.

videos.title: Zip and Zoom
videos.overview: Team Persona is a guest at Zip and Zoom.

videos.title: Memories of Sushi
videos.overview: Team Persona have to raise Robin's popularity with fans.

videos.title: Pop Production
videos.overview: Multi helps Jaxon and Robin up their fashion game.

videos.title: Black and White
videos.overview: Team Persona’s match against Yggdrasil is here!

videos.title: True Heart
videos.overview: Blaze is nowhere to be seen at the second battle of the Persona-Yggdrasil match.

videos.title: Arrival of the Fastest
videos.overview: Blaze Fujiwara finally arrives at the match.

videos.title: Proof of the Fastest
videos.overview: The battle to determine the team's results for the Persona-Yggdrasil match has begun.

videos.title: Invitation
videos.overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest, an event where B4 breaks existing teams apart and creates a new group of teams, will be held.

videos.title: The End of Persistence
videos.overview: Takumi is holding Bey battles against multiple amateurs for some reason.

videos.title: The King and the Phoenix
videos.overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest has finally begun! In this event, previously unimagined teams clashed from the very first match.

videos.title: Mask and Meat Buns
videos.overview: The Battle between Blader X and Jian begins. Titus tells Mr. Taisho how he met the Zooganic members and what makes them strong.

videos.title: Riddles and Pop
videos.overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest continues, and Multi's team, Multi and Me, goes up against Top Boyz.

videos.title: My Teammates
videos.overview: The match between Team Multi and Me and Team Top Boyz enters its final battle.

videos.title: New Partner
videos.overview: The last day of the Shuffle Battle Fest has arrived, and Robin's team, Found Family, is ready for battle.

videos.title: Our Promise
videos.overview: It's the Found Family's final battle and time for Meiko Myoden to take the stage.

videos.title: A Rainbow Guest
videos.overview: Jaxon and Robin are helping out at Komaba Sushi when Sigrid Nana-iro comes looking for something to eat.

videos.title: The Dream Contest
videos.overview: Now that the Shuffle Battle Fest voting polls have closed, the All-Star Battle is set to begin!

videos.title: Bladership
videos.overview: Robin loses in the All-Star to Packu, Multi picks up where he left off.

videos.title: Unpredictable
videos.overview: The second Blader for the dreams is the unpredictable Rex Jura.

videos.title: Return of the Queen
videos.overview: It's time for the living legend, Quinn Manju, to take the stage.

videos.title: The Greatest Blader
videos.overview: The final clash of the All-Star Battle is underway.

videos.title: The Other Mask
videos.overview: Someone calling themselves Blader Y appears in Xenon City, battling Pro Bladers.

videos.title: The Three Masks
videos.overview: Blader Y’s not the only masked stranger hunting pros.

videos.title: XYZ
videos.overview: It’s up to Robin to come up with a plot to lure out these troublesome masked Bladers.

videos.title: Pendragon, Back Then
videos.overview: This is a story of how Team Pendragon used to be.

videos.title: Family, Back Then
videos.overview: Multi tells Robin about the history of his Bey, Scythe Incendio.

videos.title: You, Back Then
videos.overview: A young Blader arrives in Xenon City, full of dreams.

videos.title: Time Off
videos.overview: Robin heads back to his hometown with Jaxon before the title match.

videos.title: Battle at the Top
videos.overview: At last, it’s Team Persona’s battle against Team Pendragon.

videos.title: The Nana-iro Showdown
videos.overview: Multi goes up against Sigrid Nana-iro in the first battle of the title match.

videos.title: Something Xtraordinary
videos.overview: Pendragon’s second Blader is Khrome Ryugu; it's Blader X's turn to take the stage.

videos.title: The Two Xs
videos.overview: After a head-on collision cracks Buster Dran, Khrome reflects on his time with Jaxon.

videos.title: The Most Fun Ever
videos.overview: In the final battle, Blader Z seeks revenge while Robin is cheered on by his teammates.

videos.title: Restart
videos.overview: They might have lost, but Team Persona still has their sights set on the top of The X.

videos.title: Signs of a New Era
videos.overview: Zooganic and Yggdrasil are likely candidates to be contenders in the next Title Match.

videos.title: Path of Resolve
videos.overview: With Khrome missing, Team Pendragon is not allowed to battle in an official match.

videos.title: Advance Bey Timeshift
videos.overview: Takumi's visit to Yggdrasil Research is interrupted by Karla Konjiki.

videos.title: Star Plot
videos.overview: Tenka Shiroboshi appears at Komaba Sushi, demanding a battle with Blader X.

videos.title: Tri-Blader Battle
videos.overview: Finally, Team Persona's next match has been set against not one but two teams!

videos.title: Triple Battle
videos.overview: When Zonamos passes on an opportunity to pose a riddle, Multi knows something is up!

videos.title: Blader S
videos.overview: With Blader X indisposed, a new Blader helps Team Persona: the mysterious Blader S!

videos.title: The Multi-Coloured Trial
videos.overview: Blaze, Zonamos, and Yuni go to a remote Yggdrasil Research lab when a guest arrives!

videos.title: Invincible
videos.overview: At last, Blader X takes on Tenka.

videos.title: The Prestigious Bey Academy
videos.overview: Multi visits the prestigious Bey academy to ask an old mentor for help.

videos.title: The Manju Clan
videos.overview: On the quest to learn more about Beycrafting, Multi visits the home of the Manju Clan.

videos.title: The Shapeless Shadow
videos.overview: While chatting with Joka, Multi expresses feelings of anxiety towards this ‘new era’.

videos.title: First Flight
videos.overview: When Tenka asks Robin what made him start Blading, he reminisces about his old friend.

videos.title: Something Captivating
videos.overview: Robin wants to give Tsubasa advice, but he needs to prove his strength as a Blader.

videos.title: Silver Wolf
videos.overview: Packun shares a rumour that could upend the Blading world!

videos.title: Light and Dark
videos.overview: Ginro invites Jaxon to join the fight to save the world from the Shadow Pros.

videos.title: Shadowy Underground
videos.overview: Ginro and the others try to rescue Packun from the Shadow Pros.

videos.title: Dread Dragon
videos.overview: Byte appears and tempts Ciel with the power of the ‘Dread Dragon’.

videos.title: To That Place
videos.overview: Khrome has been missing but now he’s come face to face with Omega Shiroboshi.

videos.title: Labyrinth of Riddles and Terror
videos.overview: Zonamos House hosts an event where fans get to battle Blader X…if they can solve riddles!

videos.title: The Star Battle
videos.overview: The Star Battle begins: Pro and Amateur Bladers launch into battle.

videos.title: Cursed
videos.overview: When Persona meets with Gordias, their first battle is between each team's leader.

videos.title: Return of the Knight
videos.overview: Multi completes an epic Beycrafting journey and returns to Team Persona with a new Bey!

videos.title: The Path of the Demon Dragon
The Fox's Seven Forms, The Tanuki's Eight Forms
The X That Devours The Stars
Destruction
videos.overview: The Persona fan meeting is a huge success. As rumors of a pro blader hunt spread, the identity of the 100th challenger in the challenge battle becomes clear...!?

videos.title: The Second X
videos.overview: The Persona group rushes outside after experiencing a violent tremor, only to be shocked by a sight. Furthermore, a giant hologram of Kurosu Zero declares that Beyblade is doomed...

videos.title: The End of the Demon Dragon
